elements.name: Tomo D1
elements.long_name: Tomography detector D1 (gh1 camera), hutch E
elements.notes: Tomo D1 in E. CONFIRMED by the user AND by the CS-Studio display: the Tomo D1 button opens the 1idGH1: ADSpinnaker panel (PGR_GS3-U3-123S6M), i.e. the gh1 camera is on Tomo D1; the same button also opens 1ide1:m47 'tomo_E_shielding' (the tomo shield; mpe_bluesky lists m47 under d2E). 'Tomo_E' screen (cs14: E-Tomo Y, Rz, X, Z; axes +Y up, +Z beam, +X into the screen) = 1ide1:m40 (Y), m38 (Rz), m63 (X), m62 (Z). On the panel Tomo D1 is drawn above the beam line and NF D2 below it (both beside the Aero SMS), so they look like alternative detectors moved into the beam rather than in series (inferred, unconfirmed). The tomoEds axes (m111, m112) are NOT here: the user says they belong to the Radiograph (2026-11-13).
